extract_web_documents_from_html: convert an HTML dataset into web documents with texts and images using DOM simplification
download_images_from_urls: download images from a URL list file using img2dataset with configurable shard size and resize mode
create_dataset_from_downloaded_images: create a HuggingFace dataset from downloaded image tar files with a URL to index mapping
replace_urls_with_images: replace image URLs in a dataset with actual image objects using a URL to index map
save_sharded_dataset: save a dataset as sharded train and valid splits with configurable shard size
